_doc: python3 tools/assets/vessels/lobster_liveries.py — the Downeast lobster fleet's identities: 100 boats, each with a name, a hailing port, a design family and length, her paint (topsides, deck and house top, bottom, boot stripe, rub rail, the lettering) and her buoy colours, which she flies on her mast as Maine requires and which mark every trap buoy in her string. Writes models/vessels/lobster_liveries.json (data: traffic picks boats from it; MODELS.livery paints a model with an entry). Generated by tools/assets/vessels/lobster_liveries.py; do not hand-edit.

materials.lob_boot: boot (hidden when null: painted as the bottom)
materials.lob_name_tr: name and port on the transom
